entries.description: SILVER CIRCLE FARM is an intentional community and working farm on 40 acres in Holly Springs, Mississippi. It is home to 4 residents (2 wimmin on the land and 2 in different cities). The group welcomes new members/residents, girl and boy children, nonlesbian women, and dogs on leash. Focuses include organic gardening, woodswonsmanship, natural healing, carpentry, plumbing, organic farming, and alternative lifestyles.
entries.raw_text: SILVER CIRCLE FARM c/o Gwen O Demeter, Rt 5 Box 100, Holly Springs, MS 38635. We are presently two wimmin living on the land and two wimmin living in different cities who share financial/emotional responsibilities for caretaking 40 acres. We are an intentional family of four who enjoy the support of several other extended family members who visit regularly to help with the farmwork and enjoy its special energy. Our interests include spiritual tolerance and development, organic farming, prosperity thinking and being, networking, and providing a working example of an alternative to patriarchal patterns. We give training in survival back to the earth skills: organic gardening, woodswonsmanship, natural healing, carpentry, plumbing, etc. We welcome: new members/residents, girl & boy children, nonlesbian women, dogs on leash. We have/are: 4 lesbians, 40 acres, housing/permanent structures, electricity, outhouse, running water in kitchen, camping space, woods, farmland, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative because it calls itself 'an intentional family of four' and lives on the land. Accepted groups: 'girl & boy children' and 'nonlesbian women' are explicitly stated. Focuses: 'organic gardening' and 'organic farming' give Farming/self-sufficiency; 'natural healing' and chemical-free practices or survival back to the earth skills give Environmentalism/eco-friendly. Land location inferred from the mailing address as it is the place they live and caretake.

entries.description: SPIRAL WIMMIN'S LAND TRUST is a land trust located 7 miles from Monticello, Kentucky, sitting on 250 acres. It has 33 residents (30 lesbians, 3 nonlesbians). The space is open to membership for wimmin to live, camp, or attend workshops. Welcomes new members/residents, girl children, and nonlesbian women.
entries.raw_text: SPIRAL WIMMIN'S LAND TRUST PO Box 337, Monticello, KY 42633 (606)348-5215 (7 mi from Monticello). Spiral is an all wimmin's space, open to membership. Supportive Membership is for wimmin to use the land for camping/workshops or just to be supportive. Community Membership entitles one to live here, be part of the community and own one's own improvements. In brief, our purposes say: To hold land in perpetuity, for wimmin to form community, to grow food organically, to provide education of alternative skills, etc. We welcome: new members/residents, girl children, nonlesbian women. We have/are: 30 lesbians, 3 nonlesbians, 250 acres, 1 house, 1 barn, electricity, camping space, woods, farmland, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type is Land Trust because the name and purpose state it is a land trust ('To hold land in perpetuity'). Accepted groups: 'girl children' and 'nonlesbian women' explicitly welcomed. Focuses: 'all wimmin's space' gives Lesbian separatism; 'grow food organically' gives Farming/self-sufficiency; 'provide education of alternative skills' gives Workshops/education. Num residents: 30 lesbians + 3 nonlesbians = 33 residents. Land city and state inferred from contact address and stated distance.

entries.land_location_as_stated: NW Michigan 1 hr from Traverse City - Jordan River Valley
entries.description: O.W.L. SANCTUARY is an intentional community located in NW Michigan (Jordan River Valley) near E Jordan, sitting on 40 acres with 6 residents. It centers on spiritual, nature-oriented, and Lesbian feminist perspectives, and vegetarianism. Welcomes new members/residents in Fall '86, wimmin of color, girl children, and dogs.
entries.raw_text: O.W.L. SANCTUARY Rt 1 Box 209-A, E Jordan, MI 49727 (616)536-2903 (NW Michigan 1 hr from Traverse City - Jordan River Valley). In May '85 land, with two smallish houses, a barn, apple trees, critters and nature spirits, was purchased. We see our primary focus as a spiritual. one, experiencing. and developing our psychic, spiritual and nature-all inter-connectedness with a commitment to aid the healing of the Earth Mother. Our spirituality is eclectic in its background and manifestations, but has a decidedly Lesbian feminist emphasis. The community space is considered basically vegetarian and incomes are shared. Future goals include sponsoring wimmin's gatherings and events, creating ongoing Lesbian spiritual circles, establishing a liaison with area Native wimmin and offering a healing, contemplative space to wimmin needing sanctuary. We welcome: new members/residents in Fall '86, wimmin of color, girl children, dogs. We have/are: 6 lesbians, 40 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, woods, women living on the land.
entries.notes: Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative because members own/live on the land and share incomes. Accepted groups: 'wimmin of color' and 'girl children' explicitly named; 'nonlesbian women' is not explicitly named, but 'wimmin of color' includes non-lesbian women of color, so we code Non-lesbian women as per standard rules. Focuses: 'spiritual... inter-connectedness' gives Spirituality/ritual; 'decidedly Lesbian feminist emphasis' and 'sanctuary' gives Lesbian separatism; 'wimmin of color' gives Women of color. Land location inferred from the mailing rural route address.

entries.land_location_as_stated: Atwood, on Lake Michigan in NW lower peninsula
entries.description: MAPLE ROW FARM is an intentional community on 70 acres near Ellsworth (Atwood), Michigan, with 2 residents. It features a clean, sober stone cabin, garden, berry and fruit farm, and writer's hermitage. Visions include a woodworking collective and horse care. Welcomes new members/residents, girl children, Native American Women, and other dykes of color.
entries.raw_text: MAPLE ROW FARM Rt 1 Box 88, Ellsworth, MI 49729 (616)599-2013 (Atwood, on Lake Michigan in NW lower peninsula). We live in a clean and sober, nicotine-free 80-year-old stone cabin with 2 cats. We have a car, truck and motorcycle, a 30' x 50' garden, a foundation for another building, and septic and electrical hookups available for a trailer. Many adjoining acreages for sale. Visions are for a woodworking collective, berry and fruit farm, writer's hermitage, and horses once the land is paid off (Dec '86). We welcome: new members/residents, girl children, Native American Women, other dykes of color, dogs. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 70 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods, farmland, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative because residents live on the land and welcome new members. Accepted groups: 'girl children' and 'Native American Women, other dykes of color' explicitly named, meaning Non-lesbian women is included via women of color. Focuses: 'berry and fruit farm' and garden gives Farming/self-sufficiency; 'woodworking collective' and 'writer's hermitage' gives Workshops/education and Archives/cultural work; 'Native American Women, other dykes of color' gives Women of color. entries.community_name: WICOMIS WOMYN'S LAND CO-OP - D.O.E. FARM
entries.description: WICOMIS WOMYN'S LAND CO-OP (D.O.E. Farm) is an intentional cooperative land community on 80 acres in Norwalk, Wisconsin, with 6 to 15 members in the group and 4 year-round residents (more in summer). Features a half wooded campground, half hayfield, orchard, and garden. Welcomes new members/residents, girl children, and nonlesbian womyn.
entries.raw_text: WICOMIS WOMYN'S LAND CO-OP - D.O.E. FARM Rt 2 Box 42, Norwalk, WI 54648 (608)269-5301. WWLC owns DOE (Daughters of Earth) Farm. The land is hilly, secluded, and very beautiful; half wooded campground (some chemical free space), half hayfield, orchard, garden, berries, etc, in west central Wisconsin. Four year-round residents, more in summer. Ten-year anniversary in '87. We welcome: new members/residents, girl children, nonlesbian womyn. Sliding scale fees. We have/are: 6-15 members in group, 125 members almost all lesbians, 80 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods, farmland, women living and working on the land.

entries.raw_text: EARTH CURRENT WOMENS HERMITAGE Rt 1 Box 137L, Red Rock, TX 78662 (512)764-2706 (Between Bastrop and Lockhart, south of Austin).
